title: Scaling a Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $c\in\mathbb R$, let $f\colon\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The vector Fourier coefficient of the function $x\mapsto c f(x)$ at $\gamma$ equals $c$ times the vector Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $\gamma$.
